chunks: Ali ibn Muhammad, from Salih ibn Abi Hammad, from someone else, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) who said:

Whoever recites 'We have indeed revealed it' thirty-two times in a new vessel, and sprinkles his new garment with it when he wears it, he will continue to eat in ease (plentifully) as long as a thread from it remains.

key_terms.إِنَّا أَنْزَلْنَاهُ: We have indeed revealed it (the first verse of Surah Al-Qadr)

ai.seo_question: What is the spiritual benefit and ritual for wearing new clothes according to Shia hadith?
ai.summary: In Shia tradition, this practice exemplifies the concept of *barakah* (blessing) through the sanctification of material objects via Quranic recitation, linking spiritual devotion to worldly sustenance. The specific number of recitations (32) and the use of fresh water (*mā' al-zamzam* or general blessed water) reflect the emphasis on ritual purity and the transformative power of the Divine Decree mentioned in Surah Al-Qadr. This ritual underscores the Shia belief that physical actions, when accompanied by intention and Quranic presence, can influence one's economic ease (*sā'ah*) and comfort.
